name: Phishing Investigation
description: End-to-end investigation playbook for phishing campaigns — from email triage through IOC collection and user remediation.

data.label: Quarantine Email
data.description: Pull the email from affected mailboxes. Do NOT forward or open attachments. Export as .eml for analysis.

data.label: Analyse Email Headers
data.description: Inspect From, Reply-To, Return-Path, Received chain. Check SPF / DKIM / DMARC results. Identify originating IP.

data.label: Extract & Detonate Artifacts
data.description: Extract URLs and attachments. Submit to sandbox (Any.run, MalwareBazaar). Hash all files.

data.label: Determine Scope
data.description: Search mail gateway logs for similar messages. Identify all recipients. Correlate delivery timestamps.

data.label: Reset Compromised Credentials
data.description: Force password reset for all affected accounts. Invalidate active sessions and MFA tokens. Check for mail forwarding rules.

data.label: Triage Affected Hosts
data.description: Collect EDR telemetry from machines that opened the attachment or clicked the link. Hunt for persistence mechanisms.

data.label: Collect & Share IOCs
data.description: Document sender domains, IPs, URLs, file hashes, and subject lines. Share via MISP or sector ISAC.

data.label: Block IOCs
data.description: Add sender domain/IP to email gateway blocklist. Block URLs at proxy/firewall. Create EDR detection rules.

data.label: Notify & Educate Users
data.description: Inform affected users of the incident. Provide phishing awareness reminder. Collect user reports for timeline.
